title: fix(types,runner): the retired-key pins and the runner sidebar compile against both the pinned spec and objectstack main (objectui#11330)
body:
Fixes #11330

Clause-②: no

## What was red

The required `Spec Main Shape Gate` compiles objectui against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`. objectstack `d830d71f` (objectstack#21023) changed the TypeScript type a `retiredKey()` tombstone gives a key: bare `undefined` in the pinned 17.5.0, and on `main` an inline, anonymous mark under the optional wrapper, `{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: run os validate for its migration.': never }` or `undefined`. Five objectui sites were written against the `undefined` spelling:

- four type pins in `packages/types/src/__tests__/` asserted `[X] extends [undefined]` or `Equal` of X and `undefined` on a retired key;
- `LayoutRenderer` handed the retired app `version` to a `ReactNode` slot (the sidebar's `v{app.version}` footer).

The pin, the manifests and `pnpm-lock.yaml` are untouched (objectui#9860 option C), and so are `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` and its workflow.

## Both compiles, reproduced with the gate's own flow

objectstack `main` at `b3d7a70864a7` (newer than the card's `5dbeb7d7b7e1`) was checked out in a separate worktree, `@objectstack/spec` was built and `npm pack --ignore-scripts`ed as the workflow does, and `node scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject` put it into this worktree's install. The verdict is the gate's own `report` step over the compile log.

| spec compiled against | tree | compile | gate `report` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| built from objectstack `main` `b3d7a70864a7` | base `5262f7dd3f` | `TURBO_FORCE=true turbo run type-check --continue`, narrowed to `@object-ui/types` + `@object-ui/runner` and their closure: 15 of 17 tasks ok, failed `types#type-check`, `runner#type-check` | exit 1, "5 diagnostic(s) in 5 objectui file(s)", the card's five rows |
| built from objectstack `main` `b3d7a70864a7` | this branch `f82cf777ba` | `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check --continue`, the WHOLE repository: 81 of 81 tasks ok, 0 cached, 0 `error TS` lines | exit 0, "objectui type-checks against `@objectstack/spec` at that commit." |
| published `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` (injected copy removed with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force`; 0 `[REMOVED] Key retired` hits in the installed declarations) | this branch `f82cf777ba` | `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/runner^...' build`, then `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/runner` `type-check`: exit 0 | not applicable (the pinned build is what every other CI job compiles) |

No sixth site surfaced once these five compiled.

## The helper: one spelling of "a retired key's type"

`packages/types/src/__tests__/retired-key-type.ts` (test-only: `__tests__/` is excluded from the package build, nothing re-exports it) declares `IsRetiredKeyType` of X, which is `true` for exactly two types:

- the pinned spelling, `undefined` (invariant equality, so `never` no longer passes the way `[X] extends [undefined]` let it);
- the `main` spelling: the mark, unioned with `undefined`, where the mark is matched by its STRUCTURE because the spec does not export it (it is inline on purpose): exactly one property, a literal name with the `[REMOVED] ` prefix (not a template index signature), typed `never`.

It matches the prefix rather than the whole sentence, so rewording the sentence upstream does not turn every objectui pull request red again. Everything else is `false`: `any`, `unknown`, `never`, a live member, the mark without its `undefined` arm, the mark widened by another member, a mark that admits a value, a second property, no prefix, an empty object, a template index signature. Those are the module's own direction proofs (`_NotAny` and its siblings), written as `Expect` of an invariant `Equal`, so a helper that answered `true` or `boolean` where a row says `false` does not compile. The only `any` in this diff is the input of `_NotAny`, the row that proves the helper refuses it.

## The four pins

Each still asserts the retirement exactly, through the helper, and each gains a live-key control row through the same helper:

| pin | retired-key assertion | control (must be `false`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `chartconfig-aria-retired-4044.test.ts` | `ariaAdmitsNoValue` on `chartConfig.aria` | `titleIsLive` on `chartConfig.title` |
| `dashboard-aria-retired-contract-twins.test.ts` | `ariaAdmitsNoValue` on the dashboard's `aria` | `widgetsIsLive` on `widgets` |
| `record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` | `_LayoutOnTheContractFace` on the spec props' `layout` | `_ColumnsOnTheContractFaceIsLive` on `columns` |
| `twins-spec-by-reference-9736.test.ts` | `admitsNoValue` on the page's `assignedProfiles` | `sourceIsLive` on `source` |

The `@ts-expect-error` legs on authored values were already green on both sides and are unchanged. The prose beside each assertion that said "typed `undefined`" now names both spellings.

## `LayoutRenderer`: the read is dropped, not narrowed

Measured on both sides: the twin's `AppComponentSchema['version']` is `undefined` against 17.5.0 and the mark-or-`undefined` against `main`. The key is retired on both, and the spec refuses any value at parse, so the footer could only ever render nothing on valid metadata. The read is deleted. No test or pin read it (`git grep` over `packages/runner` finds no other `version` read). Changeset: `.changeset/11330-runner-retired-version-footer.md`, `@object-ui/runner` patch.

## One-time proofs (both sides, run from the committed tree, restored and proven restored)

Mutations went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: the anchor must hit exactly once, the landing is checked on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob hash changed), and the restore is checked as blob equal to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. The compile is `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json`.

- **A: the helper loosened to "anything"** (its body replaced by `true`). Red on 17.5.0 AND on `main`, identically: all 12 `_Not*` direction proofs, plus the four pins' control rows (`titleIsLive`, `widgetsIsLive`, `_ColumnsOnTheContractFaceIsLive`, `sourceIsLive`). The one extra line, TS6133 on the now-unused type parameter, is the mutation's own artifact.
- **C: each pin pointed at its live control key** (the retired key swapped for `title` / `widgets` / `columns` / `source` in the assertion). Red on both sides, exactly four errors, one per pin's assertion line.

After both: `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.

## Tests and gates (worktree root; exit codes captured before any pipe; final head `f82cf777ba`)

- Gate reading on `main`'s spec: whole-repository compile exit 0, `report` exit 0 (table above).
- Pinned 17.5.0, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force`: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/runner^...' build` (15 of 47 projects) exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/runner type-check` exit 0, both scripts echoed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the four pin files plus `packages/runner/`: 10 files, 56 tests passed.
- `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the helper and all four pins.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exit 0 ("0 new citation(s)"); `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm changeset:check` exit 0; `pnpm check:control-bytes` exit 0; also `pnpm type-check:coverage`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, all exit 0.
- ESLint (inline config honoured, as the packages' `eslint .` runs) over the 6 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors, 7 warnings (`--format json` counts). Six warnings are on unchanged lines (five in `LayoutRenderer`, one in `record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts`); the new one is `no-explicit-any` on the `_NotAny` probe input. Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Narrowing.** The base reading covered the types and runner closure, not the whole repository. The fix reading is the whole repository, so both directions are covered for the final tree.
- **A discarded run.** The first whole-repository run on the earlier commit `8ce0077913` was stopped on purpose (SIGINT to this session's own turbo PID) when lint flagged a bare empty-object type in the helper. That run is not counted; the reading above is the later full run on `f82cf777ba`.
- **When the pin moves.** Once the pin carries the mark, the helper's `undefined` arm describes no installed spec any more and can be dropped. The module docblock says so. No tripwire was added, to keep this stop-the-bleed to its file surface.
- **Stale prose, not touched.** `packages/types/src/app.ts`'s docblock on `AppComponentSchema` still says a key the spec retires "surfaces here as an optional member typed `undefined`". That is true only of the pinned spec now. It is published source outside this card's file surface. Carrier: none.
- **Runtime.** An off-spec app document that still carries `version` no longer shows a "vVERSION" footer in the runner sidebar. The spec refuses that document at parse.
- **Install.** The injected spec was removed and the normal install restored (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force`) before the pinned-side gates ran.
